newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit up vs dollar on ringgit/Sing cross trade.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit up vs dollar on ringgit/Sing cross trade.

text.p: The ringgit firmed against the dollar on Tuesday, boosted by cross-trading between the Singapore dollar and the local currency, dealers said.

"There was some large selling of Singapore dollars for ringgit. It's more of a yield play and nothing to do with fundamentals," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank. He said Hong Kong-based funds led the ringgit/Sing buying which indirectly strengthened the ringgit against the dollar.
The ringgit breached a two-and-a-half year high against the Singapore dollar on Tuesday, dealers said.
